notes: «وابن طاوس عن أبيه يبلغ به النبي» is a second route for the same saying, written right after the first, so a second group with the same head (rule 4)
«أبيه» with no name is a relation link (rule 7)
«بمثله غير أنه قال» is a wording variant of the matn: left out; «ولم يقل يتيم» is a wording note: left out
